issues: Document uses 'Раздел N. <name>' headings (Раздел 2 БАД, Раздел 3 Медицинские изделия, Раздел 4 Парфюмерно-косметические средства, Раздел 5 Специализированные продукты питания/напитки) which were used as tr_section per row. All pages are natively landscape (no rotation needed). Rows 26-27 (Полисахариды (полифруктозаны, хитозан, β-глюкан и др.)) are struck through/crossed out in the original scan but were still transcribed per no-invent-data rule; this entry may be withdrawn from the scope. Table rows group multiple numbered normative-document line items (№ column) under one object/codes block with 1+ indicators listed at different sub-row heights; per instructions one JSON row was emitted per indicator with the full joined norm_doc list repeated for each (exact mapping of which specific norm-doc subset applies to which indicator within a block, e.g. rows 1-9, 16-17, 31-33, 49, is not preserved beyond raw_row_text's row-number range). Several diapazon values are bare numbers with no 'от'/'до' qualifier (vitamin rows 16-17, antrahinones row 18); these were placed in range_from as printed. Row 19-20 diapazon text 'Элеутерозиды, гинзенозиды: 0,001-1,00 мг/мл' had its numeric range parsed into range_from/range_to/unit with the qualifying substance names folded into the unit field. Row 29 (Стронций-90) upper bound printed with superscript exponent '1·10^8', reproduced as plain text '1·10^8'.
